global: The field at {enemy_faction}'s border was won today. The council will sort out who deserves the credit. It always does.
{troop_count} troops took that ridge. I counted, and then I counted again. The minutes will reflect this, naturally.
A fine victory. Pity the campaign ledger still has blank columns where the names of the commanders should be.
Victories are easy to announce. Votes on who shares the spoils are where things get interesting.
Good work on the field today. Let us see whether it survives a session of the council before the wine runs out.
A battle won with {troop_count} blades is a debt owed by someone. I shall be keeping a careful tally.
The banners flew for our side today. Whether they fly tomorrow depends on who speaks loudest in the hall.
{enemy_faction} lost a field today. I will leave it to the scribes to decide who earned the glory.
whisper: {player}, that flank held better than expected. I shall note it, though I note most things.
A useful day in the field. I trust our arrangement remains a matter of convenience, as it was before.
We fought well together. Do not mistake a shared battle for a shared future, {player}.
I saw you hold the line with {troop_count} men. Impressive. I wonder what you will ask for in return.
Our banners were on the same side today. The council will decide whether that means anything tomorrow.
Well fought, {player}. I shall bring your conduct to the next vote, favourably or otherwise.
Do not read too much into today. Allies are useful until the next grant of land is on the table.
A good day's work. I will be writing to the council about it, and I will mention you only in passing.
face: {player}. A fine fight today. I shall reserve judgement on whether it changes anything between us.
Ah, {player}. We held the field together. Now the real contest begins, in the council chamber.
You fought at my side and I am still deciding whether that was a kindness or a calculation. Good day.
Tell me, {player}, what did you gain from today? I always ask, and I always listen to the answer.
Our {troop_count} did well enough. Let us speak again when the vote on the spoils is called.
Walk with me a moment. The victory was ours, but the question of who holds the fief is still open.
Good work, {player}. I have seen many a fine battle end in quiet bickering over who led the charge.
We stood together today. Keep your eyes open, though. Shared banners do not always stay shared.

global: {player} held the eastern road today. Their name will be mentioned in council, and I shall make sure of it.
Our thanks to {player} and every soldier who stood with them. The council does not forget loyal service.
Few lords hold a line the way {player} did today. I intend to say so in the hall, and loudly.
Victory against {enemy_faction}, with {player} at the centre of it. A fine example for the rest of us.
I have already drafted a motion honouring {player}. Let the hall argue about it; the result is clear.
{troop_count} strong, and led with sense. {player} has earned a seat at any table I control.
Today's win belongs to all who fought, but {player} deserves a larger share of the praise.
Someone should raise a toast to {player}. I will raise the motion before the wine is poured.
whisper: {player}, that charge was magnificent. I will push for a fief grant in your name at the next session.
You fought beautifully today. I trust you remember who spoke for you when the votes were counted.
Keep this up and I may have to start calling you an ally in front of the whole council, {player}.
Between us, your stand at the ford was the reason we won. I intend to see that it is recorded properly.
I have a seat that could use someone of your judgement. We can discuss it over dinner, if you are free.
The council will hear of your courage, {player}. And I will hear whether you are still willing to work with me.
Your {troop_count} made the difference today. Let us talk about how that difference might be rewarded.
A fine day, {player}. Let us make sure the next council sitting is just as fruitful for us both.
face: {player}! That charge was splendid. Walk with me; there is a motion I want to put before the council.
I was hoping we would meet. Your stand today has given me ideas about the future of our alliance.
Do you know how rare it is to find an ally who fights well and also knows how to speak in the hall? Rarer still.
Well done, {player}. Once the dust settles, I would like to hear what you want from the next vote.
You fought well, and I intend to mention it at every opportunity. Consider it a down payment, not a favour.
Keep your banner high, {player}. The council seats are shifting, and I would like you in a good one.
Our {troop_count} carried the field. Shall we discuss what that means for the fiefs next season?
A pleasure to stand beside you today. Our shared banner looks better with you under it.
